author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the announcement trailer for RuneScape Reignited! 25 years in the making, RuneScape Reignited launches December 2, marking a defining moment for the game — inviting players old and new to return together, rediscover RuneScape and experience it as it was always meant to be. Through the Remastered Journey and Adventure Guide, alongside a fresh economy, brand-new hi scores and a focus on player first. Reignited gives players the ultimate RuneScape experience.
title: RuneScape Reignited - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a first glimpse of an ambitious new chapter for RuneScape: a fourth RuneScape MMO, built for a new generation of players. Still early in development, the as-yet-unnamed title will bring the world of Gielinor to life in Unreal Engine, combining the depth, freedom and community-led spirit that have defined RuneScape for 25 years with the technology and game design possibilities of today.
title: RuneScape - Official 4th MMO Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Reveal Trailer for Little Prince Tyger, a 2D action roguelike developed by Saltitude. Players will hunt through 1000+ single screen levels with physics simulated environments and enemies. Meet unique characters across a dark fantasy world in Little Prince Tyger, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Little Prince Tyger - Official Reveal Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Reveal Trailer for Lazare's Sacrifice, a narrative-driven deckbuilding game developed by DRI and Curve Games. Players will explore the French Revolution with nothing but a deck of cards. Summon powerful figures to the board and fight for your life in Lazare's Sacrifice, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Lazare's Sacrifice - Official Reveal Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Year Two DLC Overview for Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds, the hit action arcade racing game developed by SEGA. Players can get an extensive look at what's to come in Year 2, including new modes, features, and DLC content from hit IPs such as Bayonetta, Aigis from Persona 3, Godzilla, and content from the seminal RPG Final Fantasy 7. Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Official Year Two DLC Overview

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the DLC Reveal Trailer for Kingdom Two Crowns: Pharaoh Lands, a DLC to the hit city-building strategy tower defense game developed by Fury Studios and Coatsink. Players will explore new content with the next DLC being set in ancient egypt. Gaze upon massive pyramid monuments rising towards the sky in the valley of the kings with the Pharaoh DLC for Kingdom Two Crowns, coming soon to PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, Mac, Android, and PC (Steam).
title: Kingdom Two Crowns: Pharaoh Lands - Official DLC Reveal Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for JIAOHUN, a cinematic first-person horror game developed by 12AM Blackout. Players will explore a small Chinese town during the 1990s to embody a returning wanderer who has lost his soul. Track down your scattered spirit to gradually uncover the mystery behind the downfall of Fairy Town. JIAOHUN is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: JIAOHUN - Official Reveal Trailer (Chinese Language) | Triple-i Initiative Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Playtest Launch Trailer for Isle Goblin, a 2D survival pixel-based survival game developed by Kilowatt Games. Players will make use of tools to push back the humans from their land and rebuild what remains from the war. Isle Goblin is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a playtest available now on Steam.
title: Isle Goblin - Official Playtest Launch Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Game Tactics Overview Video for Star Wars: Galactic Racer, the hit roguelike arcade racing game developed by Fuse Games. Players can hear straight from the development team about how to break through the opposition with key tactics to gain the edge in any given race. Learn more about builds and how to best customize a speeder to your desired playstyle. Star Wars: Galactic Racer is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer - Official Game Tactics Overview

description:
Welcome to the first-ever Cozy After Dark Showcase!

Cozy on the surface. Creepy underneath.

Cozy After Dark Steam Event:

https://theyetee.com/collections/cozy-after-dark

https://www.humblebundle.com/games/cozy-after-dark-showcase-bundle?utm_source=dames4games&utm_medium=pub&utm_campaign=cozydarkoct2

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the 'Road to Season 2' Behind-the-Scenes Video for Wardogs, a first-person action multiplayer shooter developed by Bulkhead. Players can hear directly from the development team about the plans, content, and features coming with Season 2. Fans can expect an upcoming Progression Wipe, balance tweaks, and more on the way with the next season of Wardogs. Season 2 for Wardogs is launching on October 15 for PC (Steam).
title: Wardogs - Official 'Road to Season 2' Behind the Scenes Overview

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the 'Welcome to Brazil' Trailer for Crazy Taxi: World Tour, an upcoming action arcade driving adventure game developed by SEGA. Players can take a look at the scenic sights and vibrant energy of Brazil. Drift around coffee shops and speed past iconic locations around the city. Speed through Brazil in Crazy Taxi: World Tour, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour - Official 'Welcome to Brazil' Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Accolades Trailer for Minecraft Dungeons 2, the hit action-adventure RPG developed by Double Eleven and Mojang Studios. Players will enter the rift to take on tough enemies in the Sift, an unexplored region filled with dangerous battles to engage with. Protect the Overworld alone or with friends in Minecraft Dungeons 2, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Xbox Cloud, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Minecraft Dungeons 2 - Official Accolades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the demo trailer for Coal Duty, a 1–5 player co-op extraction horror-comedy. You and your crew head down into procedurally generated mines, try to hit the state coal quota, and plan your escape. Most of you come back up.



The Coal Duty demo is available now on PC via Steam, and the game will be part of Steam Next Fest from October 19–26.
title: Coal Duty - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Tekken 8 Reina Teaser Trailer for Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves, the hit fighting game developed by SNK. Players can get a look at Reina, also referred to as Purple Lightning, making her debut with the upcoming Tekken 8 collaboration. Reina is launching into Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves in December 2026 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves x Tekken 8 - Official Reina Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the 'Your Adventure Begins' Trailer for World of Warcraft: Forever, an MMO RPG developed by Blizzard Entertainment. Players will explore the sprawling world of Azeroth in a whole new way, with over 1,000 new quests to embark on. Get the rundown on the aforementioned new quests, alongside new races and rewards to attain. World of Warcraft: Forever is launching on November 4 for PC.
title: World of Warcraft: Forever - Official 'Your Adventure Begins' Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this early access gameplay trailer for Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4's DMZ Mode. Drop in, gear up, fight and extract! Take on bounties or become hunted yourself, explore the map for resources to bring back to the FOB as you build up for greater and greater risks and rewards. 
Play the DMZ mode in Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 on October 20th when you pre-order the digital edition, otherwise you can drop in on October 23rd for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC (Steam, BattleNet) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Official DMZ Early Access Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the accolades trailer for Gears of War E-Day, the latest installment in the Gears of War franchise! Taking place during the pivotal events of Emergence Day, Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago are thrust into a battle for survival against the unknown Locust threat. Joined by newcomers, Mags Carter and Lucas Reyes, the newly minted Bravo Squad must stand against the Locust Horde as they struggle to push the enemy back to where they came from. 
Gears of War E-Day is out now for Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam, Xbox on PC).
title: Gears of War E-Day - Official Accolades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this new gameplay trailer for Battlefield 6 REDSEC's Rapid Royale mode! Drop into the new Las Vegas map as you battle in smaller spaces, with fewer numbers in an effort to get as many kills as possible to earn redeploys! 

Rapid Royale is live in Battlefield 6 REDSEC on October 13th as part of Season 5 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC (Steam) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Battlefield 6 REDSEC - Official Rapid Royale Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this new look at the critically acclaimed beat-em-up Sifu, from the team at Sloclap. Taking the action on the go for the first time, you'll be able to take on the Dawn Group across several stages and battle the masters in thrilling 1-on-1 duels. 
Sifu is out now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), Nintendo Switch, PC (Steam) Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and comes to Mobile on October 12th.
title: Sifu - Official Mobile Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this new trailer for Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero Super Limit-Breaking Neo DLC! Featuring Champa, Cheelai, Jaco and King Vegeta. See their signature moves in action, and get hands on them now! 
Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero's Super-Limit Breaking Neo DLC is available now.
title: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero Super Limit-Breaking Neo - Official DB Super Character Pack Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Accolades trailer for Ace Combat 8 Wings of Theve, the latest in the long-running arcade aerial dogfighter series! 
In our own review of Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve we said "The best aerial combat the series has ever had." as the game nails the feeling of flying high through the clouds as you dogfight with other pilots in tense arcadey action! 
Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve is out now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC (Steam) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve - Official Accolades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
It's time to get rich or die trying! Check out the story trailer for Tropico 7, as you're thrust into the role of El Presidente as you build your lush island and forge deals with the British Crown or serve your own interests on your path to power! 

Tropico 7 releases on January 28, 2027 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Steam, Epic Games, Xbox on PC), and Xbox Series X|S
title: Tropico 7 - Official Story Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Launch Trailer for Valor Mortis, a first-person soulslike action RPG developed by One More Level. Master melee-based combat, read enemy attacks, and find new weapons to continue the onslaught in the name of the Emperor. Valor Mortis is launching on October 13 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC).
